description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - The detail of Chairman and Vice Chairmen in the meeting of Delft P.S. in the Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the election results for the positions of Chairman and Vice Chairman of the Delft Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority), as recorded in a meeting convened under the Local Authorities Election (Amendment) Act. It specifically names the elected individuals for these electoral positions, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
